en: Black‑and‑white streetscape showing a European city square with a small park, leafless trees, cobblestone streets and tram tracks. A single electric tramcar travels through the intersection. On the left is an ornate neo‑Gothic facade; in the center background stands a large classical railway‑station‑like building with a clock above the main entrance, and behind it a broad iron‑and‑glass train shed. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks. A round advertising column stands at the right edge of the image.
